review:
The staff (family), were amazing and very kind. They also recommend where to go and where to eat. One of the restaurants they recommended was the best we had in all of Italy - Bell'Assai.

The location is excellent!!! 

We highly recommend this hotel!

Loved the quiet park setting, fabulous pool area and large elegant restaurant and rooms.
Nothing really. It was a 30 minute walk to Ortigia., but we knew that when we booked.

Everything was great. The hosts were friendly, responsive, and provided helpful recommendations. It was a short 6-minute walk to the port. Lots of great food options nearby. The location was excellent, and check-in times were flexible.
Beautiful authentic character, appartment on the top floor of a three story walk up in the heart of Tivoli
This is a great place run by amazing hosts.

What we liked is that the owner seemed to care about the place (in comparison with the neighboring units). The walls were freshly painted. All floors nicely tiled. The patio with the sun umbrella and the lemon tree providing a lot of cool shade was great (and unexpected) bonus. We had all our meals there. It is a pity that all other neighboring units seemed abandoned. Casa di Rena seemed to be the only one which seemed to be cared of.
There was a persisting smell in the bathroom coming probably from the dry siphons in the waste water pipes (we are not sure). The owner seemed to be aware of the problem because refreshing oil was plugged in. We hate to\he resulting perfume smell and have unplugged it. Then, the smell appeared and there was nothing we could do about it. We suspect that the problem might be related to the entire complex of which Casa di Rena is just a small part. 

Also, we have not expected such a long (almost 100 m) distance from the parking to the entrance to the apartment. At the age of 80+ it is quite serious problem when we had to move all our stuff.

This is the closest place to the beach!  We had 2 rooms, one for us and one for our kids.  Both were clean.  The apartments are literally steps away from the beach and a great little coffee stand with amazing gelato.  We were so happy.

Gianicolo Penny's Garden apartment was comfortable and well-appointed and suited us very well.  The private garden that comes with the suite was a real plus.  The apartment is well-located in a nice neighbourhood that offers grocery stores, pharmacies, wine shops and restaurants nearby.  The bus into town stop right around the corner and we used this most of the time to get into and out of town.  It's a walkable distance into town, but the buses are air-conditioned so we generally opted for that, since it was quite hot when we were there.  

Patrizia is very well organized, and provides a handbook with things to know about the apartment and the features of the neighbourhood, as well as restaurant recommendations.
The bathroom has three different levels, so may not be suitable for people who are unsteady on their feet.

Also a caution to tall people - the bathroom ceiling slopes and my 6'3"  husband banged his head a couple of times, and the kitchen sink is set quite low.  It wasn't a big deal for us, though and was outweighed by the plusses.
Nice location.

The VIEW!!! Staff is very attentive and helpful. Great clean rooms. Good spread of breakfast with baked delights and fruits.dinner was a traditional Italian 3 course set menu. Both were amazing.
Parking - but the hotel advised it's tricky and paid street parking only. Be prepared to walk a bit and climb steps to get there. But if you have a seaview room, the view will be worth all that hassle. Don't lug big suitcases.. just a backpack of essentials will make it all worthwhile

From the moment of arriving, Antonio, Paolo, and Edgar were so welcoming. Not only is this hotel in the prime location of Florence; the rooms are absolutely stunning. Breakfast daily is a nice touch where you can eat in the privacy of your room or enjoy it on the communal terrace...the ham and cheese toast is the best in the city! The majority of sites, museums and attractions that Firenze has to offer are within walking distance.
I did not like that I had to leave ... I wish I could have stayed another week!

Beautiful room, patio and view.
It was a top floor unit so got a bit warm

We loved our stay at Hotel Silla.  Location was superb, away from the busy town centre, but just a lovely 10 minute walk from everything.  The hosts had some great recommendations for.local eateries and their breakfast service was brilliant.  Our only wish was for a couple more days!

Amazing location in the national park, stunning surroundings. Very quite place where you will be only disturbed by the bird songs ! Very relaxing, we had to convince ourselves to leave to see the near by sights as it was so tranquil. 

It’s just an hour away from great beaches and the local hiking is also very beautiful. 

Wonderfully decorated units that are very comfortable and stylish. Bed was very comfortable and bedding was great. Original towels are a nice touch ! 

A family that operates this place are just spectacular! You get wonderful breakfast delivered to your door every morning, and they will help with anything you need, from restaurant reservation to home cooked meal. 

This place was a treat for us; we stayed at many other places but this one was highlight !

The breakfast was very nice and the attending staff was excellent. The only issue with the location is the only available parking is at the port...quite far with luggage, would be nice if the hotel would provide a shuttle.
Great location near the station. Clean facilities with a beautiful view.

The staff at foresteria were all so so accommodating and friendly when my motorbike broke down and I was stuck there. You really get the feeling that you're cared for, and the facilities are always clean and neat. I would choose to stay at Foresteria every time I'm in Giulianova.

Jennipher went above and beyond to make sure my son, who has a peanut allergy, had a special breakfast every morning. The location was great, and only a few minutes walk to the main action. The room was always cleaned very nicely and the staff were very helpful and friendly. The beds were very comfortable, and the AC worked great. Definitely recommend this property if you are visiting Sorrento.

Washer in the room and patio
No sign outside to show location

Candid Review – 2.5/5

We were a family of four staying for just one night. I contacted the host on the same day the cancellation window expired, asking to cancel after realizing the hotel was kosher and quite far from the nearest canal stop. I explained our reason: 1 night with a family but they were unable to accommodate the request. 
To their credit, the host was friendly upon arrival and even met us near the first bridge to assist with our baggage — a thoughtful gesture we appreciated.
While newly renovated, we arrived just three days after reopening. Unfortunately, there was still sawdust in the unit and especially noticeable upon waking up and on surfaces after placing items on the table. 

The A/C didn’t work properly — it kept running even after reaching the set temperature, making the room uncomfortably cold overnight. With only a thin sheet provided and no blankets or duvet, it made for a restless and cold night..  The reception closes at 8 PM so no one to contact but I did mention to the host at checkout. 

The bathroom was newly renovated and featured a  doorless, tubless walk-in shower. However, the design caused the water to overflow across the bathroom floor after each use. It became slippery and unsafe to walk in afterward — a serious hazard, especially for children or older guests.

Location:
Located in the Jewish district, the area is very quiet and off the beaten path. It's a long walk from the canal stop, which is challenging with luggage or kids. Unless you're specifically looking for kosher accommodations, I wouldn’t recommend this hotel for a short or central stay in Venice.

Overall:
The hotel has potential, but with lingering construction dust, safety concerns, lack of comfort, and poor communication from the host, we left disappointed.
Rating: 2.5 out of 5

i could not possibly recommend this hostel more !!! i stayed here for ~4 weeks/a month while doing a scuba course with diving sea club and i LOVED it here !!!! the host (salvo) and his wife are both incredible - they were always friendly, accomodating, ready to offer advice, and very kind, yet never overbearing at all.

the location is perfect - it's less than a 1 minute walk from the fish market, which has awesome fresh fish if you're interested, but is also just a really cool experience regardless. it only takes 2 or 3 minutes to walk to the duomo, which is beautiful and surrounded by some really good restaurants/bars/etc (i'd recommend lettera 82 !!)

salvo prepares the breakfast every morning, and the reviews saying that the breakfast is good are 300% correct - it varies a bit depending on the availability of fresh ingredients but generally included coffee/tea, homemade cakes (lemon, banana, etc), mini toasts with ricotta, butter, or the amazing apricot marmalade which salvo makes himself (!!!!! 1000/10; i normally hate marmalade, but i tried it one time then ate it every single morning), fresh vegetable dishes like cucumber with balsamic and tomatoes with fresh cheese, and some things like pasta with veg or this semolina (?) dish that looks like couscous with vegetables, which i wouldn't normally expect at breakfast, but which turned out to be a godsend for lasting energy for the day while diving

the hostel is run by salvo & his awesome wife, plus reza who is a super chill guy and great to chat with, plus some volunteers who do a bit of (only very reasonable) work in exchange for staying at the hostel without charge, so all the staff is both very friendly/personable, and also just as excited about/interested in the city as the visitors are !!

He also offered us towels for the beach, he carried our luggage to the room, and gave us advice where to eat authentic Italian food and places to avoid. Excellent customer service Gaetano! generally clean enough.

The only thing I didn't like is the bathtub, it's very slippery. The shower head needs to be changed it's hard to get a good flow of water. There is also no place to mount the shower head so you have to hold it which is very difficult.

Our favorite stay of our entire trip in Italy! Traveling with our 2 year old and it was a spacious, clean, and comfy place for all of us. We had the entire apt to ourselves, and it was nice to have a full kitchen available to cook. The host was very responsive via whatsapp and left us with a map and recommendations. 10min walk from the train station and 20-30min walk to city centre. Convenient to have a supermarket 5min away and Gloria's Pasticeria is a must-try for amazing desserts. Highly recommend this place to stay!
Check out time is a little early at 10am, but we just left our bags in a luggage locker at the train station while we explored the city before having to catch our train.

It was wonderful to have space to cook and spread out in spacious accommodations after staying in (more expensive)hotels throughout the rest of our previous stay.

Amazing place - 20 minutes walking distance to Coliseum, very clean, very quiet. The host was super quick with responses AND actions - once we had a problem with power (3 kWh overall load maximum we didn't know about) late in the evening, the host came 5-10 minutes later. Highly recommend.

The location was fabulous and why we booked the apartment. There are tons of restaurants nearby. The apartment is in an old historical building so very interesting. The main bathroom was large as were the 2 bedrooms. Lorenzo was super responsive to my emails ahead of time as well as my texts while we were there. The AC quit working and he did his best to try to fix it and then brought fans for our use which helped but we did book the property expecting working AC, especially as it was hot in Rome. We found the property very quiet and the beds were comfortable. Tea and coffee were provided.
The photos did not show that the loft area had very short ceilings with wooden beams.  My husband bumped his head numerous times and had to bend over to walk around. The loft area was also very poorly lit.  The upstairs bathroom was very small. The description said 2 bathrooms with shower. We assumed this meant toilets in both bathrooms which was not the case. There was only a toilet in one bathroom, which would have been a deal breaker for us with 4 people. The shower in that bathroom was also very small with the low ceilings so we didn’t use it. Therefore, there is really only one useful bathroom.  It was difficult to get into the property. You need to have wifi to enter 2 of the doors and the wifi and data is pretty much non-existent at the second door due to the thick walls. It would be helpful to have an instruction booklet provided in the apartment. Lorenzo did show us an easier way when he came with the fans, but if we had not seen him, we would not have known this. The kitchen is very small, which was fine for us but you definitely couldn’t cook there. There were no plates provided. The kitchen sink needs replacing.
